title: nlist.get

arguments.description: nested list name to bind to

body:
[nlist.get] gets an element from a nested list. The element can be a list or a nested list, in which case you can give a list index to get a nested element. The '-1' index is a special index that gives you the whole nested list.

The right outlet gives the type of the element (0 for float/symbol, 1 for list, 2 for nested list) or an error (-1 for an out of range index, -2 for an out of depth index). Clicking on the object opens the editor window of the [nlist.define] object with the same name.
